summary: The Virginia Environmental Law Journal is a student-edited law review at the University of Virginia School of Law. It publishes research and discussion on environmental and natural resource law, covering topics from environmental justice to corporate liability. The note states that the journal is perennially ranked among the top five environmental law journals in the country.
one_line: A student-edited law review at the University of Virginia School of Law covering environmental and natural resource law.
